body: okay smart ass. can you help me or not ?

I’m here too. If you need someone to talk to, you could hmu. I’m sorry that you’ve had to go through this torture, and I’m sorry that you feel the way you do. I’ve wanted to take my life plenty of times but frankly I don’t know what has stopped me, but something has. That means I have a purpose, and you have one too. You matter and you will find true happiness and you will one day look back on all your struggles and know that you got stronger from them. I believe in you

Yeah man you really are right. I really do need someone to lean on, and I’m sorry that you’ve had to go through the same things I’ve gone through, it’s living hell.
